nodes.statement: For every natural N, every ring R, and every W : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> R, the sum of W over PrimitiveAdditiveTriple t with t.c <= N equals sum d in Icc 1 N of signed mu(d) times sum over 1<=a,b<=N, a+b<=N, d|a and d|b of W(a,b,a+b).
nodes.quantifiers: forall R [Ring R], forall N : Nat, forall W
nodes.hypotheses: Positivity, additive relation and coprimality are carried by PrimitiveAdditiveTriple; right-hand positivity and additive cutoff are explicit.
nodes.normalization: Canonical integer ArithmeticFunction.moebius cast with signs into R; coefficient multiplies sector on the left.
nodes.source_statement: Mathlib canonical Mobius divisor cancellation plus fresh finite sum proofs and exact typed bijection.
nodes.mathematical_acceptance: Exactly the named finite identity; no radical-height or target implication.

nodes.statement: Supply and prove a literal radical-height comparison with constants depending only on epsilon, uniformly in every finite cutoff and the necessary test weights; finite divisor cancellation alone supplies no such bound.
Prove the exact implication from a supplied cutoff-uniform radical-weighted moment estimate to the frozen all-epsilon pointwise ABCBound; retain test-weight admissibility and every constant.
Reindex d|a,d|b sectors by a=d*u,b=d*v with exact positive floor cutoffs and d*(u+v)<=N; then separately construct an additive Fourier projector if needed.
nodes.historical_scope_note: Original combined sector-and-projector goal retained verbatim and open. The exact finite sector identity has its own checked node; no Fourier projector has been proved here.

nodes.statement: For every Ring R, N,d : Nat, arbitrary joint W, and hd:0<d, the common d-divisor sector on positive a,b with a+b<=N equals sum over 1<=u,v<=N/d and u+v<=N/d of W(d*u,d*v,d*(u+v)).
hypotheses: 1 <= a,b; a+b<=N; d|a and d|b on the source sector
1<=u,v<=N/d and u+v<=N/d on the quotient region
nodes.normalization: Natural-number floor division, positive scaling, full joint weight and exact third coordinate; quotient pairs have no coprimality restriction.
nodes.mathematical_acceptance: Exactly the named finite identity and its declared hypotheses; no arithmetic estimate or abc implication.

nodes.statement: For every Ring R, N:Nat and arbitrary joint W, the typed primitive positive additive moment at c<=N equals sum d in Icc1N of signed mu(d) times the quotient-region sum W(d*u,d*v,d*(u+v)), with u+v<=N/d.
nodes.hypotheses: The primitive triple type retains positivity, a+b=c and Nat.Coprime a b; each outer d lies in Icc1N and is positive.
nodes.normalization: Canonical signed integer Mobius cast into R on the left; no independent-weight premise and no commutativity of multiplication required.
nodes.mathematical_acceptance: Finite exact composition only; uniform estimates and pointwise arithmetic implications remain open.

nodes.statement: Prove an exact finite character-orthogonality projector for the unscaled equation u+v=w, with a stated positive modulus q>2*M when u,v,w lie in [1,M], then justify every finite-sum interchange for W(d*u,d*v,d*w). A congruence projector alone must not be promoted to integer equality, and multiplying a congruence by d must not silently cancel d without its own hypotheses.
